loss: SUM's own objective -2*CC + 10*KL - SIM + 5*MSE (NSS dropped: ADD1000 has density maps only)
batch: min(16, n), last partial batch kept (steps = 12 x ceil(n/16)); micro-batches of 8 with accumulation weighted by micro size / batch size (exact batch mean)
device: cuda (cloud NVIDIA A10G 24 GB GPU), chunked pure-PyTorch selective scan
what_is_trained: all 57,501,196 SUM parameters (released weights reloaded for every run), domain token 2, stochastic depth as released
init: released SUM weights (hf safe-models/SUM); torch.manual_seed(1000*n + r)
scoring: 384x384: prediction (256 sigmoid output) and GT PIL-bilinear to 384, clip at 0, divide by sum; KLD eps 1e-8; *_nosigma = no post-hoc blur; *_native256 = raw 256 output vs GT at 256, no sigma
subset_rule: sample_efficiency.py: pool = folds 1-4 in order, numpy default_rng(1000*n + r).choice(pool, n, replace=False); identical to msdb_adapt_curves / curve_ours_* train_ids for every (n, r)
data_order: default_rng(r), fresh copy of the training list shuffled every epoch (as ours / IIE curves)
training_policy_small_n: fixed epochs (SUM's own 12 at every n, so steps = 12 x ceil(n/16)); no early stopping
calibration_maps: per run: the same n training maps select the post-hoc sigma (grid 0,2,...,12, mean CC); no centre prior
resamples: n = 25, 50, 100, 200: r = 0, 1, 2; n = 400: r = 0 only; n = 800: sum_ft fold 0 only (budget-driven)
n800_note: n = 800 is the finished k-fold row sum_ft, fold 0 (not rerun): same 800 training ids (folds 1-4, = the n=800 draw as a set), same recipe (SUM loss, Adam 1e-4, StepLR(4, 0.1), batch 16, 12 epochs = 600 steps; 800/16 has no partial batch). Differences from the curve runs: data order default_rng(0) shuffling the pool in fold order (not default_rng(r) over the draw order), torch seed 0 (not 800000), and sigma chosen on 200 of the 800 training maps (default_rng(0), k-fold rule) instead of all 800; the training-CC sigma table is flat (0.97387 at sigma 0, 0.97397 at sigma 2) and test CC is 0.9203 with sigma vs 0.9201 without. Sigma cannot be re-chosen on all 800 maps (no weights or training predictions were saved). One resample only.

curve.note: single resample taken from sum_ft fold 0 (see n800_note)

runs.train_ids_order: pool (fold) order as used by the k-fold path; equals the n=800 draw as a set
runs.note: n = 800 is the finished k-fold row sum_ft, fold 0 (not rerun): same 800 training ids (folds 1-4, = the n=800 draw as a set), same recipe (SUM loss, Adam 1e-4, StepLR(4, 0.1), batch 16, 12 epochs = 600 steps; 800/16 has no partial batch). Differences from the curve runs: data order default_rng(0) shuffling the pool in fold order (not default_rng(r) over the draw order), torch seed 0 (not 800000), and sigma chosen on 200 of the 800 training maps (default_rng(0), k-fold rule) instead of all 800; the training-CC sigma table is flat (0.97387 at sigma 0, 0.97397 at sigma 2) and test CC is 0.9203 with sigma vs 0.9201 without. Sigma cannot be re-chosen on all 800 maps (no weights or training predictions were saved). One resample only.
